physics-h2-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.

physics-killer-11.title: Partikilli P dirree maagneetii
physics-killer-11.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-11.material: Partikilli P dirree maagneetii wal-fakkaataa $B$ irratti qajeelaan galee sochii geengoo saffisa walfakkaataa raawwata; raadiyasiin geengoo isaa $5\,\mathrm{cm}$, yeroon isaa $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ dha. Partikilli Q dirree maagneetii P wajjin walfakkaataa irratti qajeelaan galee; massiin isaa P kan $4$ dachaa, hammi chaarjii isaa P kan $2$ dachaa, saffisni isaa P kan $3$ dachaa dha. Humni harkisa lafaa dagatamee jira. Raadiyasii geengoo Q fi yeroon isaa hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Partikilli P dirree maagneetii wal-fakkaataa $B$ irratti qajeelaan galee sochii geengoo saffisa walfakkaataa raawwata; raadiyasiin geengoo isaa $5\,\mathrm{cm}$, yeroon isaa $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ dha. Partikilli Q dirree maagneetii P wajjin walfakkaataa irratti qajeelaan galee; massiin isaa P kan $4$ dachaa, hammi chaarjii isaa P kan $2$ dachaa, saffisni isaa P kan $3$ dachaa dha. Humni harkisa lafaa dagatamee jira. Raadiyasii geengoo Q fi yeroon isaa hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$ waan ta'eef $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ saffisa irraa walabaa waan ta'eef $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Madaallii chaarjii yoo dhiisan $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ①), yeroon saffisa wajjin madaalaa yoo jedhan $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ③), madaallii massii fi chaarjii yoo dagatanii madaallii saffisaa qofa yoo fayyadaman $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ④) ta'a.
physics-killer-11.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-11.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
